Apply completion option visibility to internal ARG

The completion option's `hidden` setting applies to `--completion` but not its internal `ARG`, leaving completion-only arguments in usage lines or help entries. Pass the same visibility setting to the internal `ARG` argument of `--completion` so `true`, `"help"`, `"doc"`, and `"usage"` apply to both parts, including the help shown for a missing shell name. Existing argument visibility and rendering support are sufficient; no formatter changes are needed.

Regression tests cover every visibility mode, visible controls, grouped aliases, missing-shell help, and async help. They also check that hidden options still generate scripts and return suggestions, and that command-form help retains `SHELL` and `ARG`. Runtime completion and the visible command form are unchanged.

Fixes #1097.

:lock:(discovery-server): refuse to start in production without Redis

## :lock:(discovery-server): refuse to start in production without Redis

Sans `REDIS_URL` ni `REDIS_SENTINELS`, discovery-server démarrait avec un registre en mémoire par pod. En production la validation d'env échoue maintenant, avec la même règle et le même `path` que message-manager. Hors production, le repli mémoire reste possible. K8s fixe déjà `REDIS_SENTINELS` (`deploy/k8s/config/discovery-server.properties:11`), donc aucun déploiement légitime n'est touché.

### Related Issues
Closes #1213

### Test plan
- `bun run --filter discovery-server test` : 167 passés (cas ajouté dans `env.spec.ts`, cas prod existant complété avec `REDIS_URL`)
- `bunx biome check services/discovery-server docs` : OK
- `bun run config:check` : OK
- Non lancés en local : build:ts, reach:check, suite complète (la CI tranche)

Simplification : rien à simplifier.
Taille : +~30 / −1 (budget 80)

Start game runs at the top and give the run the first screen

Closes #203

- Every screen change in an endless game (start, stop, results, practice, back to the menu) scrolls to the top, so the menu's scroll position never carries into a run.
- During a run the page drops its breadcrumbs and title (the h1 stays for screen readers) and the run fills the viewport; the footer starts at the fold.

Verified: check, 419 unit tests, build, e2e games (twice over) and site. New e2e: a run started from a scrolled menu lands at the top with the footer below the fold at 1440×900. Checked in the browser at 1440×900 and a narrow window.

Blur play counts and other metrics on YouTube Music without catching artist names

Picking a play count on YouTube Music with "All similar" also blurred artist and album names, because those cells share identical classes.

- Polymer's `style-scope <host-tag>` classes are no longer used as selector anchors.
- When a row repeats the same cell shape with a fixed layout, the selector is pinned to the picked column (`.flex-column:nth-of-type(2)` for plays). Image card grids and variable-length tag lists still generalize to all items.
- Pick text patterns now keep the k/m/bn suffix, match `478 views` and `34m views` alike, never start mid-token (durations like `2:41`, handles like `@name777`), and keep a picked year matching only years.

Checked live on the home, artist, album, playlist, search, explore, and song pages.

🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)

Two phone e2e assertions that could not fail now check what they name

Test-only. Two phone e2e assertions found in the whole-code review of 2026-11-15 could not fail; they now check what they name. Nothing in the app changes.

## `e2e/mobile.spec.ts`, the read-only Inspector test

"Still no mutation" was `expect(await graphContent(page)).toBe(await graphContent(page))`: the graph against itself. It now compares with the graph taken before the first tap, so the tap, Details opened twice, Close and the scrim are all under it.

## `e2e/mobile-inspector-overlay.spec.ts`, the tour over a selection

- `reach()` was `!!el?.closest('[inert]')`. For a button that is not on the page that is `false`, which was also the expected value before and after the tour. It now answers `missing`, `inert` or `in reach`.
- The test read the `inert` attribute only. It now also takes a real tap where Details and where Deselect are drawn while the tour is up: the tap must land on neither the panel nor the tour's popover, open no sheet, keep the selection, and leave the tour at step 1 of 6.

## Checked

- Both tests pass locally on the `mobile` project, the only project these two specs run under (one run each, `--workers=1 --retries=0`). Neither compares a snapshot.
- I did not run a mutation to watch the new assertions fail; the claim that they can is from reading them.
- `tsc -b` clean, lint 0 errors and 88 warnings (the count on main), all 26 `check:*` scripts pass. The full e2e suite runs on this PR's CI.

## Not in this PR

- `e2e/mobile.spec.ts` 411–417 (Escape in the phone's language search): it passes because of a product defect, so it is to be corrected together with that behaviour.
- The assertions on elements that can no longer render (`toHaveCount(0)` on removed classes) go with the dead-code removal.
